messages.subject: Low-Carbon Energy Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Thomas Thor Team,

Your global leadership-search work across nuclear, low-carbon energy and workforce consulting is closely aligned with my background in regulated, stakeholder-intensive environments. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where low-carbon growth depends on credible institutional engagement, regulatory discipline and responsible execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
